from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ProvidedPaper(BaseModel):
    """One paper in the collection: its title and which OTHER provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    references_other_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")
    is_cited_by_other_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper (if determinable from the text)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    provided_papers: list[ProvidedPaper]
